name: Wangapeka Study & Meditation Retreat Centre
retreatOptions: Multi-day residential retreats, lengths vary by program
about: A long-running, purpose-built retreat property in the Nelson back-country, host to a mix of Buddhist, psychological, and meditation-focused residential programs for around 50 years. One of the oldest dedicated meditation retreat properties in New Zealand, though its eclectic, non-sectarian program mix means individual course traditions vary.
